title: Night Patrol of the Stone Hall
premise: A long museum drama under cold-stone galleries and glass-case reflections. Maisui and Aye are easily confused by looks; the celadon lotus jar goes intact_display→glaze_cracked→glued_repaired; after patrol cart Nightwatch is wrecked it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; stateless entities use appearance. Flashbacks may write state on present items.

states.prime_patrol: Night patrol Old Shi in his fifties, gray crew cut, deep-gray security uniform and black leather shoes, patrol baton and key ring at the waist, eyes alert yet tired.
states.knee_hurt_cane: The same Old Shi after a knee injury: right-knee brace, walking slowly on an aluminum crutch, still in that faded deep-gray uniform.
states.deceased: Old Shi lies still on the narrow duty-room bed with eyes closed, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_intern: Young Maisui: a lean museum intern of sixteen, wheat-yellow scarf, light-gray vest, a celadon-shard badge on the left lapel, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_docent: Adult Maisui: an upright docent in her twenties, still in wheat-yellow scarf with celadon-shard badge, steady manner.

states.intact_display: A half-man-tall celadon lotus jar, plum-green glaze intact, lotus petals in relief on the belly, cold light flowing inside the glass case.
states.glaze_cracked: The same celadon lotus jar with spiderweb cracks across the glaze, rim slightly chipped, cold light splintering at the cracks.
states.glued_repaired: The celadon lotus jar returns to display after glue repair and fill; fine repair lines remain on the glaze, distinct from the original intact state.

states.intact: A deep-blue leather patrol log with the museum crest on the cover, hourly checkpoints recorded in fountain pen.
states.ink_stained: The same patrol log stained by a spilled ink bottle, cover blackened, writing bled into ink blotches.

states.intact: A deep-blue patrol electric cart with white Nightwatch lettering on the door, basket holding a flood flashlight and seal rolls.
states.step_wrecked: The deep-blue electric cart hits the steps, nose dented, basket spilled—wreckage that can no longer patrol.

states.young_visitor: Young Aye: face closely matching Maisui's, but ochre scarf, a film-roll badge on the right lapel, more swaggering look.
states.adult_photographer: Adult Aye: face closely matching adult Maisui's, still in ochre scarf with film-roll badge, camera on the shoulder.

E7.name: stone hall gallery
E7.appearance: The main gallery floored in cold stone, celadon in the central glass case, spotlights set in the walls, clear echo.

E8.name: front granite plaza
E8.appearance: The granite-step plaza before the museum, flagpoles and guide boards in rows, night lamps turning the stone cyan.

E9.name: storage dark corridor
E9.appearance: A narrow dark corridor to the artifact storage, safes and hygrometers on both sides, only emergency lights dim yellow.

E10.name: old annex ruins
E10.appearance: Ruins of the old annex in a park corner, empty window frames, plaster peeling to red brick.

E11.name: founding brass plaque
E11.appearance: A founding brass plaque nailed to the stone-hall lintel, carved with Old Shi's name and founding year, edges mottled with verdigris.

E12.name: thermo-hygrometers
E12.appearance: Three white thermo-hygrometers set by case number on the stone stand beside the celadon case.

E13.name: Cleaner One
E13.appearance: A brand-new light-green cleaning electric cart with Cleaner One on the door, mop buckets in the bed—nothing like Nightwatch.

E14.name: Security director Old Chu
E14.appearance: Security director Old Chu in his fifties, gray crew cut and deep-gray uniform close to Old Shi's build, but gold director insignia on the shoulder boards.

E15.name: spotlights
E15.appearance: A row of five cold-white spotlights set in the east-wall light trough of the stone hall gallery, shades wiped clear.

E16.name: closing bronze bells
E16.appearance: Two closing bronze bells hung at the stone-hall doorway, bodies engraved with Quiet, chiming lightly when the wind rises.

E17.name: volunteer docent Xiaosu
E17.appearance: Volunteer docent Xiaosu, sixteen or seventeen, wheat-yellow scarf; at a glance like young Maisui, but no celadon-shard badge on the left lapel, shy unfamiliar eyes.

E18.name: fake lotus jar
E18.appearance: A half-man-tall fake lotus jar shaped like the celadon lotus jar but grayer glaze and shallower relief.

E19.name: gray-white works truck
E19.appearance: A strange gray-white works pickup with barrier boards in the bed, no Nightwatch lettering—nothing like Nightwatch.

features.E2: Maisui: wheat-yellow scarf, celadon-shard badge on left lapel.
features.E6: Aye: face nearly identical to Maisui, but ochre scarf, film-roll badge on right lapel.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard confuse sample: Maisui and Aye look alike; tell them apart only by scarf color and badge.

scenes.setting: Stone hall gallery night patrol (introduce five spotlights · two closing bronze bells)
actions: At dusk Old Shi pushes the door into the stone hall gallery; the celadon lotus jar stands intact on display in the glass-case cold light.

actions.action: A row of five cold-white spotlights is set in the east-wall light trough of the stone hall gallery; Old Shi checks each brightness in turn.
Two closing bronze bells hang at the stone hall doorway; Old Shi reaches out and lets them chime lightly.

actions: Old Shi circles the glass case of the celadon lotus jar, checking seals and humidity readings.
Old Shi looks out the window toward the sky beyond the front granite plaza.

actions.action: The intact celadon lotus jar stands quietly at the center of the stone hall gallery.

actions: Old Shi sits on a stone bench and dozes in the spotlight glow.
The air conditioner hums low; Old Shi buttons the uniform collar tight.

scenes.setting: Logging the patrol log
actions: Old Shi opens the patrol log and notes this hour's checkpoints in fountain pen.
Old Shi draws a humidity curve in the patrol log.
Old Shi closes the patrol log and returns it to the duty-desk drawer.

actions.action: Cold light from the celadon lotus jar sweeps Old Shi's profile.

actions: Old Shi gently wipes fingerprints from the glass case with a soft cloth.

scenes.setting: Granite plaza greets the intern (introduce three thermo-hygrometers)
actions: On the front granite plaza at dawn, Old Shi greets young Maisui driving up in deep-blue Nightwatch.

actions.action: Maisui jumps down from Nightwatch and retightens the wheat-yellow scarf.
Old Shi points to the three thermo-hygrometers on the stone stand and teaches Maisui the safe ranges.
Maisui crouches on the granite steps and curiously traces the relief letters on the guide board.
Old Shi points to the stone-hall lintel and explains the closing route to Maisui.
Maisui looks back at parked Nightwatch, eyes full of longing.

actions: They lean side by side on a flagpole, listening to distant morning city noise.

scenes.setting: Storage dark corridor (Aye alone)
actions: In the storage dark corridor, Aye in an ochre scarf glances back from behind a safe.
Aye fiddles with a hygrometer in the dark corridor; the film-roll badge glints lightly.
Aye snaps the storage-zone numbers on the wall with a phone, smiling with swagger.
Aye carries a camera through the shadow of the storage dark corridor.
Emergency lights flicker; Aye stops to hear the overhead duct hum.

scenes.setting: Lookalike pair co-present in one segment
actions: On the front granite plaza, Maisui and Aye stand side by side—one wheat-yellow scarf, one ochre scarf.
Maisui hands Aye a thermo-hygrometer; they smile at each other.
Aye smooths Maisui's scarf; they walk slowly down the stone steps.
Maisui and Aye part at the east end of the plaza, each walking opposite ways.
Night lamps come on; their backs—one yellow, one ochre—slowly pull apart.

scenes.setting: Patrol log ink-stained
actions: Months later at night, Old Shi keeps watch alone in the stone hall gallery; the celadon lotus jar stands quiet on display.

actions.action: Old Shi opens the patrol log and finds the cover stained by an ink bottle, writing bled into ink blotches.

actions: Old Shi wipes mist from the glass case of the celadon lotus jar.
Old Shi looks out toward the black front granite plaza.

actions.action: The outline of the celadon lotus jar slowly resolves under the spotlights.

actions: Old Shi slips the stained patrol log into a file pouch and sighs.

scenes.setting: Exhibition seasons turn (filler · stretch the gap)
actions: Seasons turn; Old Shi pushes the door into the stone hall gallery day after day.
Another snowy night, Old Shi wraps his uniform tight beside the celadon lotus jar.
At spring install, Old Shi checks seal numbers in the stone hall.
At high summer noon, Old Shi wipes glass-case rims dried by the air conditioner.
Through autumn rain, cold light on the celadon lotus jar turns dull in the damp.
Another New Year's Eve, Old Shi keeps the stone hall gallery alone until dawn.
The night before a special show, Old Shi calibrates the thermo-hygrometers two hours early.
On a full-moon night, Old Shi sets all spotlights to display level.
When a cold snap hits, Old Shi hangs a wind curtain on the stone-hall door.
Around Qingming, Old Shi sweeps leaves and grit from the front granite plaza.
In plum-rain season, Old Shi checks storage humidity again and again for overruns.
On the first frost of winter, Old Shi's white breath drifts under the spotlights.
In anti-theft drill week, Old Shi tests every checkpoint sensor once.
On New Year's duty, Old Shi sorts the key ring beside the duty desk.
On a blizzard night with roads closed, Old Shi paces the stone hall listening to the wind.

scenes.setting: Long-night patrol supplement
actions: For three visitor-free nights running, Old Shi memorizes the checkpoint order again and again.
One night humidity spikes; Old Shi has to add a dehumidifier.
The glass case clicks lightly; Old Shi looks up at once to check the celadon lotus jar.
At three a.m. Old Shi sips ice-cold tea from a thermos.
He sorts the thermo-hygrometer numbers by the stone stand.
The closing bronze bells chime lightly in the wind; Old Shi looks up to listen.
As the sky pales, Old Shi logs the last checkpoint set of the night.
Before locking the hall, he takes one last look at the intact glaze of the celadon lotus jar.
After the rain stops, he sweeps pooled water on the steps toward the drain.

scenes.setting: Plaza patrol (recall thermo-hygrometers · gray-white works truck)
actions: At daybreak Old Shi patrols the front granite plaza; deep-blue Nightwatch is parked by the flagpole.

actions.action: Old Shi crouches to check Nightwatch tires and the seal rolls in the basket.
Old Shi walks to the stone stand; those three thermo-hygrometers still sit in neat order.
A strange gray-white works truck drives along the park road, barrier boards in the bed—not Nightwatch.
Old Shi stands on the granite steps and records last night's humidity peak.
Old Shi straightens the guide board again.

actions: Distant morning fog lifts, revealing deeper city outlines.

scenes.setting: Night of tremor (glaze cracks · Nightwatch wrecked)
actions: Nearby construction tremor rises suddenly; the stone hall gallery shudders uneasily; the celadon lotus jar rocks hard.
The glass case hums; Old Shi rushes to the emergency brace frame.

actions.action: A crisp crack—spiderweb cracks burst across the celadon lotus jar glaze; the rim chips slightly.
On the park road, deep-blue Nightwatch jolts hard in a sharp turn.
One impact sends Nightwatch into the steps, nose dented, basket spilled.
In the stone hall, Old Shi lunges at the glass case and fiercely steadies the rocking celadon lotus jar.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (Nightwatch old photo indirect reference · spotlight recall)

actions.action: The day after the tremor, Old Shi stands in the stone hall gallery staring at the cracked celadon lotus jar.
Old Shi traces the crack path through the glass with a finger, face dark.
On a sticky note beside the patrol log, Old Shi writes the date Nightwatch was wrecked.
An old photo of Nightwatch hangs on the stone-hall wall; Old Shi gazes long.
Old Shi takes down one of the five cold-white spotlights from the east wall and sits alone in the faint light.
The damaged celadon lotus jar still stands cracked at the center of the glass case.

scenes.setting: Glue repair (third state · fake lotus jar false friend)
actions: Weeks later Old Shi helps the restorer bring glue tools and begins repairing the celadon lotus jar.

actions.action: Old Shi takes a fake lotus jar from a wooden crate—it looks like the celadon lotus jar but with grayer glaze.

actions: The restorer carefully glues and fills; Old Shi steadies the base beside.

actions.action: The last repair line is polished smooth; the celadon lotus jar enters its glued-repaired state.

actions: The repaired celadon lotus jar returns to display; Old Shi looks at it with relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: Cleaner One and security director Old Chu

actions.action: A light-green Cleaner One rolls onto the front granite plaza—nothing like the already-wrecked Nightwatch.
Security director Old Chu walks onto the plaza and talks shoulder to shoulder with Old Shi; their builds are alike.
Old Chu points at Cleaner One and explains the new park roster to Old Shi.
Cleaner One drives off; Old Shi alone watches it leave the plaza.

actions: Wind flaps the roster sheet Old Chu left behind.

scenes.setting: False friend: volunteer docent Xiaosu who resembles Maisui

actions.action: Outside the museum arrives volunteer docent Xiaosu in a wheat-yellow scarf; at a glance she looks somewhat like young Maisui.
Xiaosu tries reading the guide board, but Old Shi shakes his head—she is not Maisui after all.
Xiaosu leaves the front granite plaza with tour leaflets; her back fades down the park road.

scenes.setting: Knee-hurt cane (closing bronze bell long-range recall)

actions.action: Years later at dusk, Old Shi with a right-knee brace leans on an aluminum crutch outside the stone hall gallery.

actions: Old Shi looks up at the lintel on his crutch, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two closing bronze bells at the doorway chime lightly in the wind; Old Shi stops on his crutch to listen.

actions: On his crutch Old Shi presses a palm to the cold stone wall of the hall, as if saying goodbye.
He slowly sits on the steps, braced leg stretched straight.

scenes.setting: Maisui returns · Old Shi dies

actions.action: By day, adult Maisui returns along the park road and hurries toward the stone hall gallery.

actions: Maisui reunites with crutch-leaning Old Shi outside the door; they embrace.

actions.action: By the narrow duty-room bed, Maisui holds Old Shi's thick but ice-cold hand.
Old Shi's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and dies.
Maisui gently sets Old Shi's patrol baton back by the pillow.

scenes.setting: Relics · founding brass plaque (indirect reference)

actions.action: Old Shi's deep-gray uniform still hangs behind the stone-hall door; Maisui reaches out and gently strokes it.
By the lintel, adult Maisui stands before a newly nailed founding brass plaque.
Maisui's fingertip traces Old Shi's name carved on the founding brass plaque.

actions: Wind rises; closing bronze bells chime faintly afar; Maisui lifts her head.

scenes.setting: Reunion (adult confuse on both sides)

actions.action: Adult Aye arrives from the imaging department and embraces Maisui tightly outside the stone hall.

actions: Maisui and Aye stand side by side by the lintel—one calm, one swaggering.
They look at each other in silence, faces similar yet different.
Aye raises the camera, then quietly lowers it, only standing with Maisui.

scenes.setting: Memory flashback (temporal locate)

actions.action: The shot returns years—that youth tracing guide-board relief letters on the granite steps appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth tracing guide-board relief letters on the granite steps

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the stone hall, a plum-green glaze lotus jar is lit by spotlights for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the plum-green glaze lotus jar first lit by spotlights at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to the storage dark corridor that year—a figure in an ochre scarf with a film-roll badge flashes past.

anchor.phrase: the figure in an ochre scarf in the dark corridor that year

actions.action: Again that row of five cold-white old trough lamps on the east wall.

anchor.phrase: that row of five cold-white old spotlights on the east wall

actions.action: Back to that granite-step plaza of first meeting; flagpoles in rows as before.

anchor.phrase: that granite-step plaza of first meeting

scenes.setting: Close (stained patrol log · thermo-hygrometer long-range)

actions.action: Maisui reopens the ink-stained patrol log and walks into the stone hall gallery.
On the stone stand, those three thermo-hygrometers still sit in neat order.
Maisui takes over watch of the celadon lotus jar; cold light flows again.

actions: Outside the stone hall, the step outline slowly clears in morning light.
